# verda auth

Manage shared credentials and profiles

Manage Verda shared credentials and the active auth profile.

Configuration is resolved from multiple sources in order of precedence:

```text
1. Command-line flags (highest priority)
2. Environment variables with VERDA_ prefix
3. Credentials file: ~/.verda/credentials or --credentials-file path
4. Built-in defaults
```

Subcommands:

- [`verda auth login`](#verda-auth-login): Save API credentials for a profile
- [`verda auth show`](#verda-auth-show): Show the resolved auth profile
- [`verda auth use`](#verda-auth-use): Switch the active auth profile

## verda auth login

Save API credentials for a profile

Save credentials to a shared credentials file in AWS-style INI format.

Default file: ~/.verda/credentials
Override with --credentials-file or VERDA_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE.

Credentials are stored per profile:

```text
[default]
verda_base_url      = https://api.verda.com/v1
verda_client_id     = your-client-id
verda_client_secret = your-client-secret
```

**Usage**

```text
verda auth login [flags]
```

**Flags**

```text
      --base-url string           Verda API base URL (default "https://api.verda.com/v1")
      --client-id string          Verda API client ID
      --client-secret string      Verda API client secret
      --credentials-file string   Path to the shared credentials file
      --profile string            Credentials profile name (default "default")
```

**Examples**

```bash
# Interactive wizard (prompts for all fields)
verda auth login

# Non-interactive with flags
verda auth login \
--client-id your-client-id \
--client-secret your-client-secret

# Staging profile with custom API endpoint
verda auth login \
--profile staging \
--base-url https://staging-api.verda.com/v1 \
--client-id staging-id \
--client-secret staging-secret

# Custom credentials file
verda auth login \
--credentials-file /path/to/credentials \
--client-id your-id \
--client-secret your-secret
```

## verda auth show

Show the resolved auth profile

Show the active auth profile and shared credentials file path.

**Usage**

```text
verda auth show [flags]
```

## verda auth use

Switch the active auth profile

Set the default auth profile in ~/.verda/config.yaml.

If no profile name is given, an interactive list of available
profiles is shown.

**Usage**

```text
verda auth use [PROFILE] [flags]
```

**Flags**

```text
      --credentials-file string   Path to the shared credentials file
```

---

Global flags such as `--output`, `--agent` and `--debug` work with every command: see [Global Flags](../commands.md#global-flags).
